description: Office Français de la Biodiversité: drainage datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Office Français de la Biodiversité. Coverage: Office Français de la Biodiversité. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drainage; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Caractérisation des fossés sur la commune d'Audenge à proximité du Par; Taux de recouvrement des herbiers de zostères naines par télédétection; Cartographie des herbiers de zostères naines par photo-interprétation ; Evolution des herbiers de zostères naines sur la fosse de Loix entre 1. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
